correctness.rationale: The proof inductively enumerates all overlap-free binary words up to length 48 and uses an exact dynamic-programming recurrence for all last-square cuts. A second complete enumeration using all 122 overlap-free square blocks reproduces the nine shortest lengths and counts, and certifies exactly two length-48 nine-square words with one nine-factorization each. All finite ranges and endpoints are covered. The included verifier ran from the delivered package and printed VERIFY_OK; no infinite proof relies on sampling.

value.rationale: The sharpness witness in the 2026 ten-square theorem raises a natural minimal-length extremal question. The certificate proves 48 optimal, two unique-complement shortest words, exactly one decomposition per minimizer, and the full 1-to-9 spectrum, with a notable 24-to-48 jump between eight and nine factors. This is a natural finite complete classification with precise mathematical motivation, not an arbitrary restricted slice.
